title: desmodium tiliifolium var. stenophyllum
intro: Desmodium tiliifolium var. stenophyllum, commonly known as Stenophyllium desmodium, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Stenophyllium desmodium include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Stenophyllium desmodium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
